description.p: scidCommunity is a community-enhanced fork of SCID (Shane's Chess Information Database), a chess database application that allows users to store, organize, and search through large collections of chess games. It includes chess engines for playing against the computer and analyzing positions. Any Xboard or UCI compatible engine is supported.
scidCommunity offers enhancements not present in the upstream SCID, including:

ul.li: Enhanced Header Search dialogue with a "Layouts" button for saving and loading frequently-used search parameters
Improved Engine windows with depth and move time input controls for limiting engine calculations
Download TWIC Games feature for importing the latest weekly games from The Week in Chess
PGN Window buttons for uploading games to chess.com and lichess.org, and querying the Lichess 7-man tablebase
Alt+s hotkey for quick access to the Search button

description.p: scidCommunity displays graphical trends and produces printable reports on players and openings. You can also play online on FICS, and study endings with endgame tablebases.
The Stockfish chess engine is included in the package.
